public_requirements: An agent in config.acp.agents may declare default_model and default_effort; a create or ensure request for that agent that names no model (or effort) requests the default.
A model or effort the request names, or that a resumed session inherits from its parent, wins over the default.
Defaults belong to the agent that declares them, and do not enter start_spec_hash.
default_model and default_effort are optional non-empty strings; null or absent means none.
GET /config reports an agent's defaults as defaultModel and defaultEffort on its runtimes entry, and omits each one the agent does not declare.
